summary: Two clients on a NIFTY future: a Quote holder, then a Depth holder moves the preference from QUOTE to FULL in one frame; one FULL packet serves both, with its OI; the Depth holder leaving moves it back to QUOTE and the Quote holder keeps streaming.

notes: The web adds a second preference (FULL beside QUOTE) and keys token_map by the security id with the mode subscribed last; the Depth holder leaving deletes that key (paytm_adapter.py:500-501), so the web's Quote holder receives nothing more.

deviations.reason: The web passes Paytm's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.

The desktop sends the canonical last_quantity beside last_trade_quantity in Quote; the Paytm web adapter's Quote frame names it last_trade_quantity only (paytm_adapter.py:715). Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends last_trade_quantity from Quote up (names.rs `from`); the Paytm web adapter's Depth frame names the value last_quantity only (paytm_adapter.py:734). Open until wire's WebName.to; in the fan-out case the web's Quote holder also gets the Depth dict (C08).

The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an instrument beside the web adapter's own change keys (change_absolute, change_percent); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes. Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).

The Paytm web adapter publishes only the tick's own mode topic, and the proxy hands a Quote holder the Depth topic's dict unchanged (book and circuits included); the desktop's Quote frame is cut at Quote. Open until wire's C08 one-dict fold (decision 2026-11-09: lower-mode frames of one-dict brokers carry the richer packet's keys as the web sends them).

deviations.reason: When the Depth holder leaves, the web adapter deletes the security id from token_map (paytm_adapter.py:500-501) although the Quote holder's preference is still on the wire, so every later packet is dropped as untracked and the web's Quote holder receives nothing more. The desktop moves the preference back to QUOTE and keeps streaming to it.
